### Author checklist
- [ ] Task scope and ownership respected; shared changes approved.
- [ ] Required AC/tests evidence supplied; NOT RUN explicitly recorded.
- [ ] No keys, PII, raw scan payload, real scam links or mock success claims.
- [ ] Security/privacy and contract/dependency changes are explicitly stated.
- [ ] Handoff actionable; canonical docs delta included or requested.
